articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Enhanced Reasoning and Multimodal Capabilities
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significant improvements in long-horizon reasoning, native multimodal understanding across text, image, audio, and video, and a substantially larger context window. Benchmarks show marked gains in graduate-level science and mathematics, with the model demonstrating more reliable chain-of-thought reasoning and reduced hallucination rates compared to GPT-4o.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Sets New State-of-the-Art on Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra, which tops SWE-Bench Verified and a new internal agentic software engineering benchmark with over 65% autonomous resolution rates on real-world GitHub issues. The model introduces improved tool-use orchestration and a planning module that enables multi-step debugging workflows with minimal human intervention.

articles.title: Figure AI Deploys Humanoid Robots on BMW Assembly Lines at Scale
articles.summary: Figure AI announced that its Figure 02 humanoid robots are now operating across multiple BMW manufacturing plants in South Carolina, performing bin-picking, parts transfer, and quality inspection tasks alongside human workers. The deployment marks one of the largest commercial humanoid robot rollouts to date, with over 200 units actively working in production shifts.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Household Task Completion
articles.summary: Tesla showcased its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robot performing end-to-end household tasks including laundry folding, dish loading, and object retrieval using a vision-language-action model trained on large-scale teleoperation data. The demonstration highlighted improved fine-motor dexterity with its redesigned 22-DOF hands and real-time obstacle avoidance in cluttered home environments.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Agents with Persistent Memory and Sandboxed Code Execution
articles.summary: Anthropic released a major update to its Claude platform enabling persistent conversational memory across sessions and sandboxed code execution environments for agentic workflows. The system allows Claude to maintain project context over weeks, autonomously write and test code, and interface with external APIs, positioning it as a long-running AI collaborator rather than a single-turn assistant.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node for Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed it has started volume production on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process technology, with initial customers including NVIDIA and Apple. The node delivers approximately 25% performance improvement and 35% power efficiency gains over N2, which is expected to enable a new generation of AI training and inference chips targeting 2027 data center deployments.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins with First Compliance Audits of Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits under the AI Act, targeting major foundation model providers including OpenAI, Google, and Meta regarding systemic risk assessments, transparency obligations, and red-teaming documentation requirements. The audits signal the beginning of substantive regulatory enforcement and could set global precedents for how large-scale AI systems are governed.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Next-Gen Atlas with Real-Time VLA Control for Warehouse Logistics
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics, backed by Hyundai, revealed an updated electric Atlas humanoid robot now powered by a vision-language-action (VLA) model that enables real-time semantic understanding of warehouse environments and adaptive manipulation of irregularly shaped packages. Field trials in Hyundai logistics centers showed a 40% throughput increase over conventional robotic arms for mixed-SKU palletizing tasks.
